_note: The course: every video in viewing order. The video scripts, the companion pages and the course map all read their titles, one-line summaries and 'watch next' from here, so a title is changed in one place. 'id' is the script's id (scripts/video/scripts/<id>.mjs); an entry with no id has no script yet. 'path': true marks the two groups watched in order.
